ruleDefinitions.name: New or Renamed User Account with '$' Character
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the creation of a user with the "$" character. This can be used by attackers to hide a user or trick detection systems that lack the parsing mechanisms.
 Note: Unmapped fields: SamAccountName, NewTargetUserName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4720 AND SamAccountName = RGX(".*\\$.*")) OR (event_id = 4781 AND NewTargetUserName = RGX(".*\\$.*"))) AND  NOT ((event_id = 4720 AND dest_user = "HomeGroupUser\$"))
